cta.title: Get Your Call Schedule Done Right
cta.description: Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices who already trust Scheduling Wizard with their scheduling. Finished schedules in your format, with redrafts through the year included.

faq.answer: A resident call schedule automation tool uses software or a managed service to generate on-call schedules for residency programs automatically, replacing manual spreadsheet builds. Scheduling Wizard goes further than self-service software by operating as a done-for-you managed service, programs submit their rules and receive finished, ACGME-compliant call schedules as Excel files, with no software to learn or operate.
faq.question: What is a resident call schedule automation tool?

faq.answer: ACGME compliance is built into the schedule as it is created, not checked manually after the fact. Our team applies the 80-hour weekly duty hour limit, 10-hour rest minimums, 24-hour shift caps, and subspecialty-specific call rules when building every schedule. The rules are applied as we build from appearing in the output, not flagged for a human to fix later.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard enforce ACGME call schedule compliance?

faq.answer: Yes. Subspecialty-specific ACGME rules are built into the schedule itself. ACGME compliance, including specialty-specific call rules, is the most common question asked on sales calls, and it is the area our team was built to address with precision. Programs can also submit any additional program-specific rules as part of their rule submission.
faq.question: Does Scheduling Wizard know my subspecialty's specific ACGME call rules?

faq.answer: Self-service scheduling tools require your chief residents to learn, configure, and operate the software, and relearn it every year when leadership rotates. Scheduling Wizard is a managed service: your program submits rules and receives finished call schedules as Excel files. There is no platform to log into, no software to master, and no knowledge loss when a chief transitions out.
faq.question: How is Scheduling Wizard different from self-service call scheduling software?

faq.answer: Yes, and many programs do. Scheduling Wizard handles schedule creation and optimization, then delivers finished schedules as Excel files that your program can upload directly to whatever platform you already use for day-to-day schedule access. Scheduling Wizard replaces the schedule building process, not your existing publishing and communication tools.
faq.question: Can I still use your existing platform alongside Scheduling Wizard?

faq.answer: Programs submit their scheduling rules, including ACGME duty hour requirements, subspecialty-specific call rules, resident preferences (vacation, conferences, moonlighting), coverage minimums, and any program-specific rules. Scheduling Wizard's team turns these inputs into a finished, optimized call schedule delivered as a ready-to-use Excel file.
